subject: Web Development
title: JSON Replaces XML
description: A short lesson to help you apply JSON Replaces XML.

hook.text: In the early web, XML was the standard way to exchange data between systems.

buildup.text: XML was verbose. Sending a simple list required dozens of opening and closing tags.

discovery.text: JSON used JavaScript's object syntax: lightweight, readable, and trivially parseable.

twist.text: JSON wasn't a new invention. It was just JavaScript objects written as text, formalized.

climax.text: By 2015, JSON had replaced XML as the default data format for nearly every web API.

punchline.text: JavaScript's syntax became the web's data format.

quiz.question: What did JSON replace as the web's main data format?
